questions_before_times: The kind of bike (road, mountain, kids', e-bike, cargo); what's wrong, in a few words (picks the service and the time); for an e-bike, the motor's maker (who may work on it). Flow B: where the bike will be (a driveway, garage or office lot) and where the van can park.
safety_stop: An e-bike battery that is swollen, hot, smoking, hissing, smells of burning, or was in water or a fire. Brakes that don't work, or a cracked frame or fork. A crash with someone hurt.
staff_skills: Any mechanic does standard work; e-bike motor and battery work only by trained staff; fits only by the named fitter; the van tech works alone (an emergency contact is required).
messages_never: Nothing beyond the master's rules (no health or money details).
